timing_boundary: Preflight API through CSV report completion; imports/startup excluded; process wall retained separately. Context includes parser evaluation plus projection; inventory includes CSV headers.
cpu_memory_boundary: Sixteen supplementary SSD trials: time.process_time around same API/report interval, psutil current RSS and Windows peak working set after timing. No polling, allocation tracing, cProfile or monkeypatches in native trials. Peak includes startup/imports.
profiles: Separate A/B SSD cProfile passes, preflight/report after imports, never pooled with native timings.
guards: Frozen snapshot content, seven source-control/database hashes, batch hash and metadata for all 50 SSD input files; checked before/after each supplementary trial. Model paths resolve physically to local SSD.

parity.cross_storage: Complete records equal after replacing only mapped-drive/UNC model roots with local root; no other fields/order normalized. UUID generation deterministic during parity-only parse, restored before evaluation.

limitations: Warm/unspecified caches; no flush or cold-SMB experiment.
Storage sessions were sequential, not interleaved; storage differences are not causally isolated.
Additional balanced blocks were selected after reviewing initial results; inferential summaries are exploratory.
CPU and memory were collected only in the supplementary 16 SSD trials.
All-site phase counters are from the separate SMB observer; A/B SSD cProfile is separate corroboration.
No production change, solver, model write, multiprocessing, worker tuning, merge or release.
privacy: Only anonymous aggregates/code audit published; raw flags, paths, manifests, full records, CSVs and profiles stay private.
